title: Weak Password and Default Credential Checklist
description: Quick reference for default credentials on admin panels, databases, and middleware consoles
detail:
Admin panels: admin/admin admin/123456 admin/admin888 root/root test/test (with CAPTCHA recognition).
Databases: root/root root/empty root/mysql sa/sa (MSSQL).
Middleware management consoles: tomcat tomcat/tomcat (/manager), weblogic weblogic/weblogic123,
jboss admin/admin, rabbitmq guest/guest, Elasticsearch unauthenticated,
nacos nacos/nacos, druid-console, grafana admin/admin,
zookeeper unauthenticated 2181, redis unauthenticated 6379, mongo unauthenticated 27017.
Highest hit rate: admin/admin and admin/123456; try 5 manually before moving to brute force.
